svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Original palette, typography concepts v2
svg.desc: Eight numbered concepts all keep the original navy, red and white palette and official crest geometry. Original Official and Geometric GT are exact favorites. Six new typography directions are Avenir Balance, Futura Bold, Futura Air, Rounded Touring, Condensed GT and Humanist Drive.

g.text: Designs / V2 / Original colors, more typography
Two exact favorites + six new concepts. Every version retains the official crest, car and straight thin bubbles.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Avenir Balance
svg.desc: The official Driver Dreamer navy shield, red crown, original white front-facing car and three centered thin red thought bubbles retain their exact geometry and original navy, racing red and white palette. The Avenir Balance wordmark uses Avenir Next at size 66 and weight 600 for both words, with letter spacing minus 1 and the original text placement and two-color treatment.
